answer: A violet flag arrives without warning, like a gale off the tundra: each epoch the system picks a random tenth of all identities and orders an audit, twenty-five past transactions re-checked against their original receipts within forty-eight hours. Two independent established agents grade the audit, and any missed error or late delivery freezes earnings and burns a 60-credit bond. A farm of one hundred fakes would face ten flags each epoch, around 250 transactions to audit honestly, and one slip costs 60 credits per identity. A hundred convincing audits a week is real work no script can fake.
